gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-noto-trad: Tall, striding, a little swashbuckling: Eight Bit Dragon spaces its letters wide and varies its strokes just slightly. Noto Traditional Nushu is the friendlier sans, with broad-nibbed strokes that never curl shut and bowls filling the line.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-numans: Numans spreads its rope-thick lowercase out with generous tracking, and its s hangs its ends far from the spine. And Eight Bit Dragon strides along up top, bold and adventurous, its tall letters thinning gently at the arches.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-onest: A towering lowercase and widely spaced letters give Eight Bit Dragon an adventurous, bold stride. Onest, a contrast-free sans-serif with short ascenders over big bowls, handles the quieter work of being approachable.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-open-sans: Strokes that vary just enough to feel alive give Eight Bit Dragon its bold, adventurous character. While Open Sans, a smooth sans with bulky lowercase and no clogged curves, handles the plain talking.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-orienta: Orienta breathes, with hollow-reed counters and little height gap between cases. What stands out most is texture: Eight Bit Dragon lets its light strokes recede only slightly, while Orienta stays open.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-oxygen: Widely separated letters give Eight Bit Dragon an adventurous stride, with mild tapering where strokes bend. And it earns its keep in big, short lines, while Oxygen is the plain sans whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-parkinsan: Adventurous from the first glance, Eight Bit Dragon stretches its letters wide and lets its stems run slightly thicker than the links. Parkinsans, a plain sans with uniform strokes, keeps its wide-mouthed letters crisp when shrunk.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-pathway-e: Pathway Extreme reads clearly, its rounded letters open and its ascenders stubby beside a big x-height. And Eight Bit Dragon, with its stone-carved heft and towering stride, gives the plain sans something bold to lean against.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-preahvihe: Preahvihear reads with a lofty x-height and mouths like pried oyster shells. Eight Bit Dragon leads with a soft cadence of fuller stems and slimmer links, while the plain sans simply carries the text.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-pt-sans-c: PT Sans Caption has big-bodied lowercase and bowls that feel unclosed. Pen-like weight variation up top, in Eight Bit Dragon, gives that inviting body a bold, adventurous partner with real character.
